title: Contact Form
description: A complex form challenge featuring custom validation logic, accessible error states, and responsive grid layouts. Focuses on interactive radio groups, checkboxes, and state management for success messages.

title: FAQ Accordion
description: A functional FAQ component built using semantic HTML5 details and summary elements. Focuses on accessible design, hover states for interactivity, and responsive layouts using CSS Grid.

title: Interactive Rating Component
description: A clean, accessible rating component that captures user feedback. Features a custom radio-button scale, state-swapping with JavaScript, and a 95% accessibility score via Lighthouse.

title: Frontend Quiz App
description: A functional multi-choice quiz application featuring category selection, progress tracking, and score calculation.

title: Password Generator App
description: A functional password generator application that lets the user generate a password based on selected options, copy it to the clipboard and see a strength rating.

title: Tip Calculator App
description: A tip calculator that splits a bill between any number of people. Features live calculation, preset and custom tip percentages, input validation and a reset button.

title: Time Tracking Dashboard
description: A dashboard that switches activity stats between daily, weekly and monthly views. Data is loaded from a JSON file and rendered dynamically into the cards.

title: Newsletter Sign-up Form
description: A newsletter sign-up form with email validation, clear error messaging and a success state that confirms the subscription.

title: Article Preview Component
description: An article card with a share button that reveals a social links popup. Focuses on toggling UI state with JavaScript and adapting the layout between mobile and desktop.

title: Meet Landing Page
description: A multi-section marketing landing page with a responsive layout, decorative background patterns and a clear call to action.

title: Testimonials Grid Section
description: A testimonials section built on CSS Grid, with cards that rearrange cleanly from a single column on mobile to a multi-column layout on desktop.

title: Four Card Feature Section
description: A feature section made of four cards with coloured accents. Focuses on CSS Grid layouts and keeping spacing consistent across screen sizes.

title: Product Preview Card Component
description: A product card that swaps its image between mobile and desktop using the picture element. Covers responsive images, typography and hover states.

title: Recipe Page
description: A content-heavy recipe page that practises semantic HTML, lists, tables and readable typography.

title: Social Links Profile
description: A clean, card-based profile layout featuring a collection of social links. This project focuses on mastering basic CSS Flexbox, semantic navigation lists, and hover state transitions for interactive elements.

title: Blog Preview Card
description: A responsive content card featuring a clean layout and hover states. Focuses on foundational CSS skills like box-shadow techniques, custom typography, and semantic HTML structure using the time element.

title: QR Code Component
description: A fundamental layout challenge focused on CSS positioning, border-radius, and responsive typography. Utilizes semantic HTML structure with figure and figcaption for optimal SEO and accessibility.
